principles: Golden paths are hermetic and deterministic unless explicitly marked live.
A golden path validates user request routing, use-case transitions, persisted state, and observable outputs.
Golden paths use public tools/contracts rather than private helper internals.
Golden paths complement unit/regression tests; they do not replace them.
A golden path failure blocks release when release_gate=true.

paths.name: Start new project
paths.purpose: Prove a clean request can route to project initialization and hand control to atomic-task execution.
assertions: UC01 initialized outcome transitions to UC03
existing first task pointer is preserved for UC03

paths.name: Continue previous baseline
paths.request: продолжи прошлое исследование из старого архива
paths.purpose: Prove a reusable baseline can be inventoried/bootstraped and handed to the normal execution path.

paths.name: Paid-work research pipeline
paths.request: собери programming jobs и выясни за какие небольшие задачи платят
paths.purpose: Exercise the core research control-flow from raw paid work through normalization, measurement, decision, and checkpoint.
assertions: synthetic normalized and measurement artifacts persist

paths.name: Daily monitoring and diff
paths.request: что изменилось с вчера по известному направлению
paths.purpose: Exercise dated observations, comparable daily runs, change detection, and monitoring handoff.
assertions: day-2 diff detects one changed and one new entity

paths.name: Add and persist a research source
paths.request: добавь этот источник в реестр источников
paths.purpose: Exercise source-management routing, schema-valid source persistence, and checkpoint handoff.
assertions: source registry accepts a canonical source record

paths.name: Method change requiring migration
paths.request: измени метод исследования; для этого нужна миграция проекта
paths.purpose: Exercise project-local method-change routing, migration handoff, supported upgrade, and return to normal execution.
